VIRO-0002.title: Prove multi-contour vector model before boolean tools ship
VIRO-0002.outcome: Existing vectors migrate to document v6 without visual change, while a multi-contour vector can render a subtract-created hole and survive save/reopen before production boolean commands are exposed.

rejection.reason: GAP AUDIT FINDING (claude-audit-cloud1, main @ 6d4d7b6): the packet's before-state is stale. Document v6 multi-contour vectors, the v5->v6 widening migration, EvenOdd compound-path rendering and contour validation already landed on main via 84936c2, and Phase-A Pathfinder booleans via 9a22f8e. All six acceptance criteria already pass: tsc exit 0; test:unit 316/316; build exit 0; engines PASS; tests/booleans.spec.mjs 17/17 with runtime pixel proof of the rendered hole. Acceptance criterion 6 is contradicted -- main already ships the Pathfinder controls (real, not decorative). No build work remains, so no Builder should be deployed.
